definitions.cosine_conditional: Average cosine pair credit only on TAPB strictly inverted positive-negative pairs; TAPB ties excluded.
definitions.endpoint_aggregate: Unweighted mean of five complete seed fractions; conditional cosine uses pooled strict-inversion pair occurrences across those seeds, not independent biological observations.
definitions.numeric_check: Integer half-credit identity exact; float original-scorer equality checked at absolute tolerance 1e-15.
definitions.public_units: CSV repaired/broken/net are AUROC fractions, not percentage points or sample-error rates.
definitions.publication_verification: All 15 integer half-credit identities, original scalar scorer differences and three aggregate identities rechecked; input/source hashes verified. No prediction arrays recomputed or exported.
definitions.scope: All five existing TAPB fit seeds 342-346 and all three original test splits; saved fixed 0.7 TAPB + 0.3 cosine outputs only. Post-final descriptive explanation, not independent validation, biological causality, source selection or a replacement primary analysis.
